name: hv16_dbk_collar

pin_regs.reason: ot_static_cmd_target_core registers every pin in RTL (owner pin rule 19:50): cfg/desc/launch/tgt/tgt_active/tgt_fault land in pin flops (cv/dv/lv/act_q/flt_q/target_q/addr_q/data_q/base_q/limit_q/loops_q/tgt_q), cmd_v/cmd/cycle/configured/fault/active are registers; rst_n loads one pin flop (rst_q). A kit flop stage would add a redundant edge to the compiled calendar.

structural_change: HCDMA-DBK 2026-10-17: new hard leaf. Measured hv15_dbk_cp gate (1f18141cb): the folded collar's 1,844 clk_cp sinks were smeared over the whole 645.8x360.7 cluster between the 8 banks (TT insertion 421.6 / spread 126.5), rst_n 793 loads unregistered, in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26]. Successor: the collar core + both 128x256 table SRAMs (abutted N-S stack, W band for the read/command registers, E band for the host-bus pin flops) as ONE compact 151.2x129.6 leaf with its own CTS root, rst_n -> one pin flop, every pin flop-first; it sits beside the controller in the hb_dbk cluster (W face -> controller E face, E face = F20 host bus).

job.purpose: HCDMA-DBK 2026-10-17: DMA dispatcher collar of hb_dbk hardened as one leaf (core + 2 table SRAMs, own compact clock root, rst_n pin flop, flop-first pins); successor of the hv15_dbk_cp structural FAIL (clk_cp 1,844 sinks smeared, TT 421.6 / spread 126.5).
